title: Nova
wikitext:
{{About|the gem tag|the projectile behaviour|Nova (projectile behaviour)}}

'''Nova''' skills are a specific type of [[area]] skill which when used is centred in a circle around the player or [[proxy]] instead of at a targeted location. {{il|Astral Projector}} is able to modify this behaviour to allow it to cast at a targeted location.

==Gems==
===Skill gems===
There are {{Drop enabled gem count|where=items.class_id="Active Skill Gem" AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Nova"}} [[skill gem]]s with the [[:Category:Nova (gem tag)|Nova]] [[gem tag]]:
{{Drop enabled gem table
|where=items.class_id="Active Skill Gem"
   AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Nova"
}}
===Support gems===
There are {{Drop enabled gem count|where=items.class_id="Support Skill Gem" AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Nova"}} [[support gem]]s with the [[:Category:Nova (gem tag)|Nova]] [[gem tag]]:
{{Drop enabled gem table
|where=items.class_id="Support Skill Gem"
   AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Nova"
}}

Note that {{il|Arrow Nova Support}} does not have Nova gem tag as it is a [[Nova (projectile behaviour)|projectile nova]].

===Item skills===
* {{sl|id=FireBurstOnHit}}
* {{sl|Shield Shatter}} ({{il|Shattershard}})
* {{sl|Blood Sacrament}} ({{il|Relic of the Pact}})

==Related unique items==
The following [[unique item]]s are related to Nova skills:

{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=item_stats.id LIKE "%nova_spell%"
|large=1
|base_item=1
|level=1
|stat=1
}}

==Related passive skills==
===Tattoos/Runegrafts===
{{Drop enabled item table
|tables = tattoos
|join = items._pageID = tattoos._pageID
|where = items.class_id="StackableCurrency"
  AND tattoos.target IS NOT NULL
  AND items.description LIKE "%nova%"
|large=1
|description=1
}}

==Modifiers==
* {{ml|WeaponTreeSkillVoltaxicBurstDischarge}} ([[Crucible passive tree|Crucible passive skill]])
